simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to סֶדֶר (H5468) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: סֶדֶר (çeder) means order First listed occurrence: Job 10 22.

definitions.full: H5468. seder [ סֵ֫דֶר ] noun [masculine] arrangement, order (on vocalization compare Assyrian sidru , sidirtu , and Ba NB § 77 c ); - only plural סְדָרִים לֹא Job 10:22 = disorder, confusion , of the dark underworld.
definitions.rootNote: from an unused root meaning to arrange ;
